column1: # Keyword groupings of Reactome pathways, mirroring the KEGG BRITE categories
# and the GO keyword panels (workflow/resources/go_categories.tsv).
# THESE ARE NOT REACTOME'S OWN HIERARCHY. Reactome does curate a pathway tree,
# but MSigDB's C2:CP:REACTOME collection ships it flattened - one gene set per
# pathway, no parent/child links - so there is no ready "category -> member
# pathways" file to slice, the same problem GO has. Each group below is
# therefore a regular expression matched against the pathway NAME
# (REACTOME_<UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES>), not a traversal of Reactome's actual
# pathway browser tree: it pulls in sets that merely share a word and misses
# sets that describe the same biology differently. Treat a panel as "Reactome
# pathways whose names mention X", never as "everything Reactome knows about
# X". The plot subtitle says so too.
# Categories overlap by design, and a pathway may appear in several panels.
# Columns: slug <TAB> label <TAB> include <TAB> exclude
#   include  case-insensitive regex; a pathway is in the group if it matches
#   exclude  case-insensitive regex; matching pathways are dropped again (may
#            be empty, written as "-")
